critical_code_review_comments: JobMap orderedSegments now depends on [route, ug, connections] and the connection edit handlers call handleConnectionUpdate; this is consistent with the verified immediate update/persistence behavior.

End Path map logic correctly skips auto/chain spans from the item marked end_path while allowing the following item to start a new path. Note: when only a sparse saved custom connection exists, JobMap also chain-connects unreferenced adjacent items; that did not affect the user-reported end_path case and default full-chain flow, but main agent may want to review this behavior separately if sparse custom routes are intended to be exclusive.
